notes.title: The free unusual extreme speed shooter Ecto added Linux support
notes.content:
Ecto is a very fast-paced shooter playable in solo or online co-op up to 8 players, where you bunny hop around blasting robots with flower guns.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/09/the-free-unusual-extreme-speed-shooter-ecto-added-linux-support/

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 4.1 Tweaks + Fixes + LINUX SUPPORT
notes.content: [p]Howdy yall.  I got some feedback from the wonderful people in my Discord server and made some changes.[/p][p][/p][h2]What's new:[/h2][list][*][p][b]LINUX SUPPORT!!![/b] This was actually so painful to get working but I had to do it for the love of the game.  [i]If I see the word "libsteam_api.so" or "SteamAPI_Init" one more time I'm going to lose it.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Improved item dropping: Dropped items wont go through objects anymore[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hitbox detection for interactables (specifically the pedestals in the underworld)[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies can jump on top of the spawner buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Added swap mouse buttons option[/p][/*][*][p]Added scroll jump option[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed autojump checkbox missing (I must have slipped on a banana peel and pressed the hide button on it in the 4.0 release.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the enemy would get stuck inside the spawner on the client[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hit sound being too loud with shotguns[/p][/*][*][p]Added upgrade station to the underworld[/p][/*][/list][p]I'm seriously so mentally exhausted right now but we stay grinding <3 !![/p][p]~Dez[/p]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 4.0
notes.content: [h1]Big Changes[/h1][list][*][p]Revamped underworld!!![/p][/*][*][p]New puzzle in the overworld[/p][/*][*][p]Consistent jump height (you can still hold space to jump higher though)[/p][/*][*][p]New platforming puzzle in the underworld[/p][/*][*][p]New islands![/p][/*][*][p]New flower: Prairie Trillium[/p][/*][*][p]New mushroom: Jack-O-Lantern Mushroom[/p][/*][*][p]Comically large ant[/p][/*][/list][h2]Technical Mumbo Jumbo[/h2][list][*][p]Basic graphics settings.  Fast or ~FANCY~[/p][/*][*][p]Draw distance reduction[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaker-level optimizations[/p][olist][*][p]Occlusion on all objects to reduce draw calls[/p][/*][*][p]Removed secondary camera (item camera) and replaced it with a custom shader that renders items on top of everything else.  This shaved ~2ms off each frame.  I sacrificed a week of my life for those 2 milliseconds.[/p][/*][*][p]With the "Fast" graphics setting, unnecessary objects are hidden when far away.  I wrote my own system to dynamically hide them.  I made it light on CPU usage by spreading the calculations out over many frames instead of checking all of them at once.  Ex.) instead of 500 calculations per-frame,  it will check 10 objects each frame for a total of 50 frames.  Comment your favorite type of bean if you read this far lol.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Small Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Higher prices, but more chests to discover or unlock[/p][/*][*][p]Added cracked texture to asteroids that will break when you touch them[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the bone scavenger hunt item because it sucks (it too small)[/p][/*][*][p]Balance tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Too many bug fixes to count (as per usual)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Do good things[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]peace and much love dez signing off kachow mi name jeff[/p]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 3.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981030/1f838ad8db286fb514d964cd921af049b9782bdd.gif[/img]

[h1]Big Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added interaction / movement puzzle island to overworld
[*]New flying enemy "Sputnik"
[*]Playable tutorial segment at the beginning of the game
[*]New flowers and updated animations for preexisting ones
[*]Interactive tutorial island on spawn
[*]Changed movement.  Less floaty, no more autohop, added jump and bunnyhop sounds
[/list]

[h2]Small Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added barrier of sticks to the underworld well to keep players from going down there without a weapon
[*]Rainbow visual indicator for froggieman's shop (inspired by the chest from COD:zombies)
[*]Smooth fall off / respawn animation when you fall off the world
[*]Doesnt spawn scavenger hunt items that arent in the shop because that was pointless
[*]Removed "Levels" because it was too repetitive.  There's one level and then the boss.
[*]Changed prices for the shop
[*]Netcode improvements
[*]Tweaked enemy scaling for multiple players
[*]LOTS of optimizations and bug fixes (as usual)
[/list]

[b]Thanks for the support y'all.  Feel free to leave any feedback (positive or negative) in the Discord server or the Steam Community.[/b]

Peace and much love <3
~Dez

notes.title: BIG UPDATE! Pre-Alpha 2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981030/33e93ffade0ee275cc27ac4bb85122c72a047db6.gif[/img]

notes.title: Announcing Pre-Alpha!
notes.content:
[h1]Big Changes[/h1]
[list]
[b][*] Complete level progression instead of an infinite loop like in the prototype version
[*] FINAL BOSS >:)
[*] 3 Lives + collecting your soul when you die.  You lose if you run out of lives OR all players are dead at the same time in multiplayer
[*] Reworked underworld objectives that are generated on the outskirts of the level.  I will add more variety to this feature in the next update.
[*] Collect crystals in the underworld instead of having to go back and forth between the overworld and underworld to collect flowers.[/b]

[/list]
[h3]Small Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Invert Y option in settings
[*] Slightly tweaked movement
[*] New skybox aesthetic
[*] Crafting bench synchronizes over the network and doesnt act like a spawner anymore
[*] Underworld pressure plate model and sound
[*] World generation checks for tree collisions so they don't stick through islands sometimes
[*] A few more island types in the overworld
[*] You get your weapons back when you die
[*] New robot shoot sound (the old one sounded too intense)
[*] HUNDREDS OF SMALL BUG FIXES (70% of my development time goes here)
[/list]

[b]This update has been a very long time in the making.[/b]  The next update will focus on adding more items to collect, enemies to shoot, things to interact with, and things to discover.

Until next time my friends
-Dez

notes.title: Ecto Initial Patch
notes.content:
Ecto had a decent launch.  I was worried about the lack of content but it was reassuring seeing that people still had fun playing it.  This update addresses some of the most common issues with the game from day 1.

[list]
[*] Tweaked the weapon stats to attempt to balance their strengths and weaknesses better
[*] Fixed a bug where you get stuck at the bottom of the well
[*] The knife is limited to only damaging 3 enemies per hit
[*] Robots chase players more effectively at close ranges
[*] Fixed minor performance studdering on clients
[*] Held Frogs no longer get hit when attacking with the knife
[/list]

[b]Thanks to everyone who played and gave their feedback![/b]  I'm just a singular wrinkydink human being and the potential quality of what I can create is greater as I hear more people's inputs and ideas.

PEACE AND MUCH LOVE YUUUUUPPP <4
